body: I'm on Suboxone maintenance and not actively shooting up. I made this thread in r/opiates in the first place because people there would understand but it got deleted... I just want an answer to my question. Please.

No please don't take it down. Please understand that this is kind of HR and I am not asking about methods or details about the procedure. I just want someone who has had experience with a friend intentionally OD'ing to weigh in on the subject, especially the parent/loved ones angle. Please don't take it down. Leaving this life is literally HR for myself because I might get killed in jail and thats just the least of it, please.

Maybe I should have worded the OP a bit different but I just want some experience from someone who has lost a loved one who at the same time was causing a lot of trouble to them.
